title: Earth, layered
description: Five NASA visualizations, one exploratory canvas.

layers.description: Near real-time precipitation from NASA’s Global Precipitation Measurement constellation.

layers.label: Active fires
layers.description: Active fires observed by VIIRS. Fire intensity is shown in a moving five-day window.

layers.label: Carbon monoxide

layers.label: Temperature
layers.description: Near-surface temperature from NASA’s GEOS-FP weather analysis and forecast system.
